description: sflow_1d_susp_flume with MPM bed load (d50 0.5 mm), bed change (S 35 1), no suspended load and a constant bed load supply at the inflow (S 129 1, S 130 2e-5 m^2/s) with the default Exner form S 31 2: the first cell rises by (S 130 - qb) dt/((1-n) dx). Before patch SFLOW Sediment Check/0004 the supply had no effect: the flux vector of the inflow ghost cells was that of the first cell, and the inflow cell was held (S 78).
